name: GWO Championship
epitaph: The GWO Championship, first awarded to Myst in a three-way at Security Breach on 4 October 2004, then to Max Cameron in a steel cage a month later and to Lethal Weapon at Bloodshed on 29 November. Sal Clemenzo is the champion on the last card in the mirror, in February 2005.

name: GWO Canadian Championship
epitaph: The Canadian title, won by Slim Pickens on the CWO’s card of 2 August 2004 and carried in turn by Devo, Austin Fierro and Rated R, with Austin Fierro billed as champion on the last card in the mirror.

name: GWO Pacific Championship
epitaph: The Pacific title of the GWO, first held in these pages by Soul Reaver on 2 August 2004, with Tex Murrphy, Radd Matthews, Rated R, Stevie James, Kosmic Kitty and Parker Davis among its holders.

name: GWO TV Championship
epitaph: The company’s television belt, first held in these pages by Johnny K-9 in August 2004 and re-issued as a new belt in September, with Hellfire Jack, The Moose, Gerard Angelo and Slim Pickens trading it through the winter.

name: GWO Tag Team Championship
epitaph: The GWO’s tag belts, won by the Regulators on 2 August 2004 and passed to Thunder and Marla Storme, to the Smooth Kriminals, vacated after a double pin on 8 November, awarded to Beyond Control in an open match on 29 November and won by Thunder Storme in January 2005.

name: GWO Hardcore Championship
epitaph: A hardcore belt created at Maximum Impact on 1 November 2004 in a four-way won by Slim Pickens, then won by Jack Spade at Bloodshed on 29 November.
